---
title: "`r params$title`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date())`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: false
    self_contained: true
params:
  selection: NULL
  table: NULL
  title: "Selection of strains to sequence"
---

```{r strainselect-report-setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4)
x <- params$selection
tab <- params$table
added <- c("cluster", "optimal_group", "selected", "status",
           "representative", "group_represented")
metadata <- setdiff(names(x$table), added)
n_status <- table(factor(x$table$status,
                         levels = c("optimal", "supplementary", "selected",
                                    "not selected")))
```

## Summary

- **Strains**: `r x$n_strains` (`r x$n_profiles` distinct profiles)
- **Metadata used**: `r paste(metadata, collapse = ", ")`
- **Weights**: `r paste(x$weights, collapse = ", ")`
- **Optimal number of clusters** (largest average silhouette width):
  **`r x$k_opt`**
- **Maximum number of strains** (`n_max`):
  `r if (is.null(x$n_max)) "not given" else x$n_max`
- **Selected strains**: **`r length(x$selected)`**
  (`r paste(names(n_status)[n_status > 0 & names(n_status) != "not selected"], n_status[n_status > 0 & names(n_status) != "not selected"], sep = ": ", collapse = ", ")`)

```{r strainselect-report-interpretation, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(x$n_max)) {
  cat(sprintf(paste(
    "No maximum number of strains was given: one strain was selected in each",
    "of the **%d optimal clusters**.\n"), x$k_opt))
} else if (x$n_max > x$k_opt && x$fill) {
  cat(sprintf(paste(
    "The maximum number of strains (%d) is larger than the optimal number of",
    "clusters (%d). The **%d optimal strains** (one per optimal cluster) were",
    "completed with **%d supplementary strains**, taken in the clusters of a",
    "finer cut of the tree that did not contain an optimal strain yet. With",
    "categorical metadata, supplementary strains often have the same metadata",
    "as already selected strains: they add replicates rather than",
    "diversity.\n"), x$n_max, x$k_opt, x$k_opt, x$n_max - x$k_opt))
} else if (x$n_max > x$k_opt) {
  cat(sprintf(paste(
    "The maximum number of strains (%d) is larger than the optimal number of",
    "clusters (%d). The selection stops at the optimum (`fill = FALSE`):",
    "**%d strains of the budget are not used**.\n"),
    x$n_max, x$k_opt, x$n_max - x$k_opt))
} else if (x$n_max == x$k_opt) {
  cat("The maximum number of strains is equal to the optimal number of",
      "clusters: one strain was selected in each optimal cluster.\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf(paste(
    "The maximum number of strains (%d) is smaller than the optimal number of",
    "clusters (%d). The tree was cut into %d clusters and the best clustered",
    "strain of each cluster was selected. **%d optimal groups out of %d are",
    "not represented** by any selected strain (see below).\n"),
    x$n_max, x$k_opt, x$n_max, length(x$unrepresented_groups), x$k_opt))
}
```

## Choice of the number of strains

Average silhouette width for each number of clusters. The dashed line marks
the optimum, the dotted line the maximum number of strains.

```{r strainselect-report-silhouette}
plot(x)
```

## Selected strains

Metadata used for the selection; the complete metadata of all strains are in
the CSV file written with this report.

```{r strainselect-report-selected}
selected <- x$table[x$table$selected, c(metadata, "cluster", "optimal_group", "status")]
selected <- data.frame(strain = rownames(selected), selected, check.names = FALSE)
selected <- selected[order(selected$cluster), ]
knitr::kable(selected, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r strainselect-report-unrepresented-title, results = "asis"}
if (length(x$unrepresented_groups) > 0) {
  cat("## Optimal groups not represented\n\n")
  cat("These optimal groups do not contain any selected strain. Their strains",
      "are listed below with the selected strain of their cluster",
      "(`representative`), which is the closest selected strain in the tree.\n")
}
```

```{r strainselect-report-unrepresented}
if (length(x$unrepresented_groups) > 0) {
  missed <- x$table[x$table$optimal_group %in% x$unrepresented_groups,
                    c("optimal_group", metadata, "representative")]
  missed <- data.frame(strain = rownames(missed), missed, check.names = FALSE)
  missed <- missed[order(missed$optimal_group), ]
  knitr::kable(missed, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Clusters

```{r strainselect-report-clusters}
sizes <- as.data.frame(table(cluster = x$table$cluster), responseName = "size")
sizes$representative <- x$table$representative[match(sizes$cluster, x$table$cluster)]
sizes$status <- x$table[sizes$representative, "status"]
knitr::kable(sizes, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Method

The Gower dissimilarity between strains was computed on the metadata, and an
agglomerative hierarchical clustering with complete linkage was performed.
The average silhouette width was computed for every number of clusters from 2
to `r max(x$silhouette$k)`; the optimal number of clusters is the one with the
largest average silhouette width. In each cluster, the selected strain is the
one with the largest silhouette width (best clustered strain).

The complete table of strains with the selection is in the CSV file written
with this report (`export_selection()`).
